caption: The drawing depicts a pair of views of a single ornate earring, one from the front and one from the side, rendered in colored pencil or watercolor with fine detail on a beige background. The earring has a teardrop shape structure, primarily gold in color with intricate decorative elements. At the top, there is a gold, crown-like element above a rope-textured connector, leading to an open, curved, and symmetrical gold frame. Inside the frame is suspended a central teardrop-shaped gemstone or ornament in an orange or reddish-brown hue, bordered by a thin metallic outline. The side view on the right shows the earring’s profile, highlighting its depth and the lever-back hook mechanism in a matching metallic color, as well as the lateral structure of the earring, which maintains the same gold detailing and includes a cross-sectional area showing the thickness. The drawing is detailed, with subtle shadows and highlights to indicate the metallic and stone textures.
title: Earring
